evidence: Labeled with Tests and modifies src/test/data/tx_valid.json to expand test vector coverage for consensus script evaluation.
rationale: Adds a positive tx_valid test vector covering pre-segwit FindAndDelete behavior to guard against consensus regressions seen in CVE-2024-38365. Core already tested failure paths, but lacked a positive vector ensuring an opcode push containing an embedded signature is preserved. This provides worthwhile regression coverage for a high-risk consensus path, but is reasonably deferrable as Core is not currently affected.
